NEOW.talk.NYMPH_CHARACTER_NYMPH_CHARACTE: How did you know? ...Never mind. Enough strange things have happened here already.
Still no explanation... Fine. I'll go see for myself.
Mm. I'll try a different approach this time, too.
OROBAS.talk.NYMPH_CHARACTER_NYMPH_CHARAC: Pink! Heart-shaped! Now you know what I'm thinking!
Stories for gifts! Stories for gifts!
All right, all right. Then here's another story: a battered old city that looked more like a home with each passing day.
PAEL.talk.NYMPH_CHARACTER_NYMPH_CHARACTE: Wait. You want to give me your own flesh? Are you sure that's all right?
[thinky_dots]It will grow back... after I wake... Don't worry...[/thinky_dots]
[thinky_dots]Stay... rest a while... There is too much anger outside...[/thinky_dots]
[thinky_dots]Father... may be able to restore everything...[/thinky_dots]
[thinky_dots]...I'm too tired... I can't think clearly...[/thinky_dots]
Then don't think about it for now. You sleep. I'll go see for you.
TEZCATARA.talk.NYMPH_CHARACTER_NYMPH_CHA: Oh, sweetheart, come in! You smell of furnace fire. Would you like Tezcatara to warm you a snack?
Furnace fire? I may have picked it up at the Soul Furnace... I'll help clean up!
What a thoughtful girl. First, let us bake away your [jitter][b]weariness[/b][/jitter] as well.
Dear, you are hiding quite a few sparks in your heart. Let Tezcatara add a little kindling.
You always try to wipe away others' dark moods. Why not let me [jitter][b]burn them all[/b][/jitter]?
Sadness, fear, anger... They're all parts of a person, too.
All right, sweetheart. Then I shall burn away only the slightest excess char.
DARV.talk.NYMPH_CHARACTER_NYMPH_CHARACTE: Hey, little lady! That key-like chain of yours is interesting! Want to trade it for one of my treasures?
This isn't for trade. I need it for work! ...Can I look at that little thing over there?
Back again? I just dug up a pile of good stuff, though I forget where I found it! Pick whatever you want!
I found a little locked box! It looks destined for you!
...That does sound like my kind of work. All right, I'll try.
NONUPEIPE.talk.NYMPH_CHARACTER_NYMPH_CHA: What a vivid little guest! Come closer, and let me add a little more radiance.
Look at you, as though you just escaped a story full of suffering. You are dressed far too plainly.
Come. Let me grant you a radiance that will win ten thousand hearts.
I'll pass. I have no use for any of that.
TANX.talk.NYMPH_CHARACTER_NYMPH_CHARACTE: [b]TINY!! NO WEAPON!! TOO WEAK!! TAKE THIS!!![/b]
You don't always need force to solve a problem-
[b]HATE FIGHTING!! BUT KEEP GOING UP!! WHY!!![/b]
VAKUU.talk.NYMPH_CHARACTER_NYMPH_CHARACT: I can make sure you never hear those painful voices again. Just sign your name and give me [sine]one little thing[/sine].
What is 'one little thing'? Write it down clearly first.
...You are more cautious than you look.
It's normal to charge for helping people with their troubles, but the contract still has to be legal.
You want to make a broken city better. I can write your story a perfect ending: everyone will [sine]obey[/sine] you.
You are always carrying other people's pain. Give it to me, and I will keep it for you.
No. I still need this one tomorrow.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.NYMPH_CHARACTER_NYMPH: You presume to use a key to open a heart that is not yours.
How will I know it truly cannot be opened unless I try?
...Then return once more with that question.
You know that the same Spire still waits beyond the door.
The door may be the same, but the key I find is different every time.
